node.title: Re^2: capturing stdout of pipe
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
However, in the specific case of curl, my preferred answer is: don't shell out in the first place but use a module instead.

Yes, definitely!

It's an FAQ! How can I open a pipe both to and from a command?

That FAQ answer says to use [doc://IPC::Open2]/[doc://IPC::Open3|3], but for my personal tastes those are a little too low-level. If one really had to do this (of which this isn't a case), I would try [mod://IPC::Run] first.
